Dhurandhar 2 Soundtracks Submitted for Grammy Awards

Preparations are underway to secure a Grammy for the film 'Dhurandhar 2'. Nine soundtracks from the film, composed by Shashwat Sachdev, have been submitted across various categories for consideration. The focus is now on securing nominations for the awards.
